listing.name: Kult: The Temple of Flying Saucers / hunkstalker
listing.summary: Native Windows/Linux port of Kult: The Temple of Flying Saucers (Atari ST), powered by the verified C reconstruction and an SDL3 backend. Includes Spanish/Catalan packs, savestates, fullscreen scaling, and automated releases. Game data is not included.
